repo.name: OneUI Mods
repo.description: Signed releases of OneUI Mods apps for Samsung Galaxy. Includes experimental versions. See each app repository for device support and setup.

application.name: App Battery Tools
application.summary: Optional battery optimizations for supported apps
application.desc: Per-app compatibility adjustments for supported applications. Requires root and a libxposed API 102 framework. Does not add its own resident monitoring service. Individual adjustments can be enabled or disabled.
application.author: ryuya0124

application.name: Dark App Tools
application.summary: Dark themes for supported apps
application.desc: Adds system, light and dark appearance options to supported versions of SESAME and povo. Requires root and a libxposed API 102 compatible framework such as Vector. The supported host apps are proprietary; they are not bundled.
application.author: ryuya0124

application.name: Galaxy Adaptive Bar
application.summary: Adapt status bar colors to the background
application.desc: Adjusts clock text and status icons to the background on supported Galaxy firmware, with configurable fades, app transition tracking and privacy indicator motion. Requires root and a libxposed API 102 compatible framework. Android 16 and 17 support is firmware specific.
application.author: ryuya0124

application.name: Galaxy Camera Tools
application.summary: Extend supported Samsung camera apps
application.desc: Optional camera preview, lens transition and camera capability adjustments for supported Samsung Camera, Camera Assistant and Expert RAW versions. Requires root and a libxposed API 102 compatible framework. Hardware and firmware limits still apply; unsupported modes are not guaranteed.
application.author: ryuya0124

application.name: Galaxy Capture Tools
application.summary: Extend Galaxy recording and screenshots
application.desc: Adds optional recording rotation, app targeting, audio and capture controls to supported Samsung and Android recording components. Call playback can be included explicitly while preserving the selected app audio scope. Requires root and a libxposed API 102 compatible framework. Call capture availability depends on the audio route and app. Read the source README for supported firmware and activation steps.
application.author: ryuya0124

application.name: Galaxy Charge Monitor
application.summary: Read-only Samsung charging diagnostics
application.desc: Monitor supported Samsung charging state, power, temperature and current limits. Uses root to read device diagnostics and does not change charging settings.
application.author: ryuya0124

application.name: Galaxy DIAG
application.summary: Inspect supported Galaxy mobile network diagnostics
application.desc: Read supported modem and mobile network diagnostics on compatible Galaxy devices. Requires root and compatible device firmware. Available measurements vary by device and modem.
application.author: ryuya0124

application.name: Galaxy Reload
application.summary: Reload SystemUI on supported Galaxy devices
application.desc: User-initiated SystemUI reload helper for supported Galaxy devices. Requires root. Its unlock-state handling is only available when the device is already authenticated; it does not disable screen-lock credentials.
application.author: ryuya0124

application.name: Galaxy Service Panel
application.summary: Improve the Samsung Service Mode layout
application.desc: Reformats supported Samsung Service Mode screens for readability while retaining the original diagnostic data. Requires root and a libxposed API 102 compatible framework. This unofficial module does not bundle or replace the proprietary Samsung phone app.
application.author: ryuya0124

application.name: Galaxy Shutter Mute
application.summary: Control the supported Galaxy shutter sound setting
application.desc: Changes the supported Galaxy camera shutter sound setting after its required permission has been granted. Use Galaxy Shutter Mute Manager for installation on recent Android versions. Samsung firmware and regional restrictions may limit availability.
application.author: ryuya0124

application.name: Galaxy Shutter Mute Manager
application.summary: Set up Galaxy Shutter Mute through Shizuku
application.desc: Installs and grants the settings permission needed by Galaxy Shutter Mute through Shizuku. The companion app is downloaded only after the user's explicit action. Galaxy Shutter Mute remains a separate app. Support depends on Samsung firmware, region and camera version.
application.author: ryuya0124

application.name: Galaxy Update Guard
application.summary: Pause and restore Galaxy OS updates
application.desc: Disables supported Samsung OS update services and restores their previous state. Requires root. Google Play system and application updates are outside its scope. Restore the original state before uninstalling or clearing this app's data.
application.author: ryuya0124

application.name: HomePod Bridge
application.summary: Stream Android playback to HomePod
application.desc: Stream selected-app media or device playback and notification sounds to HomePod over AirPlay 2. Requires root and a compatible Xposed framework such as Vector enabled for System UI. Microphone and call audio are excluded. Includes adjustable latency and buffer controls. HomePod and its proprietary receiver firmware are not bundled. See the source README for supported devices and setup.
application.author: ryuya0124

application.name: Legacy Game Tools
application.summary: Startup compatibility for supported older game trials
application.desc: Fixes a native Unity startup crash in the supported arm64 editions of the D4DJ D4U and Sekai trials. Requires root and an API 102 compatible Xposed framework. Does not bundle games or restore discontinued online services. See the source README for the exact supported versions.
application.author: ryuya0124

application.name: One UI Home Tweaks
application.summary: Customize One UI Home and the quick panel
application.desc: Adjust supported One UI Home folder behavior, quick panel controls and developer animation settings. Requires root, a libxposed API 102 compatible framework and supported Samsung system components. Keep the source README at hand for supported firmware and reload instructions.
application.author: ryuya0124

application.name: OneUI Mods Manager
application.summary: Manage and update apps from OneUI Mods
application.desc: Browse OneUI Mods apps, compare installed versions with public GitHub releases, choose whether to include experimental releases, and download verified updates. Installation always uses the Android confirmation screen. GitHub downloads are user initiated and bypass the official F-Droid build review.
application.author: ryuya0124

application.name: Rain Compatibility Tools
application.summary: Compatibility helper for supported Rain versions
application.desc: Apply a version-specific compatibility payload to supported Rain installations. Requires root and the supported host app. Does not bundle the third-party application.
application.author: ryuya0124

application.name: Secure Folder Bridge
application.summary: Access unlocked Secure Folder files through shared folders
application.desc: Root-based access to files in an already unlocked Samsung Secure Folder, with optional work-profile access. Secure Folder authentication remains required. Does not unlock encrypted data or bypass its authentication.
application.author: ryuya0124

application.name: SIM Pilot
application.summary: Manage dual-SIM data switching
application.desc: Manage supported dual-SIM data switching through Shizuku or Shizuku Plus. Requires compatible device telephony services and explicit Shizuku permission. No root is needed when Shizuku is available through wireless debugging.
application.author: ryuya0124

application.name: Simeji Clean
application.summary: Hide selected Simeji promotional panels
application.desc: Hide the supported Simeji promotional panel shown above the keyboard when entering Google Play search. Normal keys and conversion suggestions are preserved. Requires root, the supported Simeji app and a libxposed API 102 framework.
application.author: ryuya0124

application.name: SleepStore
application.summary: Show updates for deep-sleeping apps
application.desc: Helps supported app-store components include deep-sleeping apps in their update listings. Requires root, a compatible Xposed framework and supported store versions. It does not bundle the store apps.
application.author: ryuya0124

application.name: Tail ADB
application.summary: ADB access over your Tailscale network
application.desc: Provides an authorized ADB transport restricted to the device's Tailscale interface, with per-peer shell and root permissions and network recovery. Requires root and the separate Tailscale app. It uses the selected Tailscale account's network; no Tailscale code is bundled.
application.author: ryuya0124
